title: Party Night
blurb: Loud, cheeky and chaotic. The pre-drinks pack, with spicy and wild extras.

dare: Start a conga line and lead it around the room once.
Do your best dance move from the 80s, 90s or 2000s, your choice, 20 seconds.

Let the group choose a song, then dance to the first 15 seconds with total commitment.

Do the robot, the sprinkler and the lawnmower back to back.
Hype up the person on your right like they're walking into a stadium for a final.
Pick a player and do a dramatic, tearful goodbye like you won't see them for ten years.
Perform a one-person dance battle against your own reflection or phone camera.
Teach the room a three-move dance in one minute and make everyone do it.
Blow out an imaginary birthday candle in the most theatrical way you can.
Freeze the next time someone claps, and stay frozen for a full minute.
Give everyone an Oscars-style award for tonight's party, in 20 seconds.
Pretend to be a bouncer rejecting an imaginary celebrity for ridiculous reasons.
Air-guitar the biggest solo of your life for 15 seconds.
Be an emotional aunt at a wedding giving the most heartfelt speech about absolutely nothing.
Do the most dramatic mic drop you can with an object of your choice.
Let the person on your left pick a dance for you to do to whatever song is playing.
Do a slow-motion replay of the best dance move you've seen tonight.
Pull the best group photo pose you can with two other players, then take it.
Read out the party's menu like a newsreader announcing breaking news.
Lead the room in a three-second countdown to a very anticlimactic new year.
